messages:
elena: Quick sync on audit export coverage + RBAC/view_mask. I ran validation against a few customer samples and hit edge cases around payload redaction and key rotation.
ken: good catch. which export flow are we validating? sync or async?
elena: async export job flow (create -> pending -> finalize). validation failures usually show up during finalize when KMS unwrap/sign fails.
sarah: for schema v2 are we standardizing a view_mask or separate fields? view_mask would make read-time checks cheap.
jamie: I favor view_mask: bitfield for [admin,owner,actor_self,service_integrations]. compute on ingestion. avoids query-time PII checks.
elena: agreed. and when redaction happens, reduce view_mask to admin-only unless proven safe. also include trace_id/span_id for SRE correlation.
ops-sre: implementor note: view_mask is applied by the ingestion pipeline service. must be derived from event contents and redaction policy. we need clear rules: if event contains any matched PII patterns -> admin-only.
ken: RBAC matrix for exports: tenant_admin and tenant_owner can request exports but full_payload requires explicit approval flow. tenant_member cannot request full exports. service accounts must be scoped to tenant_id and have a bind_key claim.
sarah: tests: I'll add contract tests that exercise permutations: member/admin/service-account + redacted/unredacted events + key rotation mid-job.
jamie: scoped tokens: enforce tenant binding and exp. no wildcard tenant for read:audit. middleware should check token.bind_tenant == request.tenant_id.
elena: KMS signing: each tenant has a key alias kms:t-{tenant}. export worker must request Sign on that key when finalizing. record key_id in export metadata: "key_id": "kms:t-789:v3". if key_id at finalize != recorded key, fail job and alert.
ops-sre: add explicit check in worker: before zipping, call KMS.Sign(manifest) and verify. if Sign fails with AccessDenied or KeyNotFound -> job=FAILED + push alert to SOC channel + increment metric export.fail.kms.
ken: do we allow shared org keys? that undermines tenant isolation. block shared-key usage for exports.
elena: block and surface an error to admins when they try to use shared keys for exports. small customers on shared keys should migrate.
sarah: on redaction policy: default export redacts fields matching /secret|token|ssn|credit|password|private_key/i. we will surface a hashed payload_ref (sha256) and a list of redacted paths.
jamie: sample event snippet for docs (audit.v2):
```
{
  "event_id": "e-01abc",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-28T15:22:30Z",
  "actor": {"id": "u-123", "role": "tenant_admin"},
  "action": "model.generate",
  "scope": {"tenant_id": "t-789", "region": "us-west-2"},
  "params": {"prompt_len": 120},
  "payload_ref": "sha256:abcdef...",
  "redaction": ["user_input.email"],
  "view_mask": ["admin","owner","actor_self"],
  "signed": {"key_id": "kms:t-789:v3", "sig": "base64..."},
  "trace_id": "trace-5f4d",
  "span_id": "span-9b2a"
}
```
ops-sre: also ensure export jobs are idempotent and track job_version. if job restarts due to worker crash, we must re-check KMS perms.
ken: incident playbook for suspected audit leak: revoke export tokens, pause export worker, rotate tenant key, notify tenant security contacts, run last-7d differential query for unusual access, open an incident ticket.
elena: add these action items to sec-sig board.
sarah: I'll add the contract tests and property fuzzers to CI. target Wed for first pass.
jamie: I'll draft RBAC matrix + view_mask encoding table (bits mapping) by Tue.
ops-sre: POC for key-rotation checks in worker by EOW.
ken: API docs update + example curl for export request (include scoped token example) by Thu.
security-bot: created TICKET-2146 "audit export gating & schema v2" assigned to eng-security, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TICKET-2146
elena: thanks all. leaving notes for onboarding this into sec runbook. ping if you need sample payloads or mock KMS responses. :thumbsup:
